title: EventBus same-owner selective callback unregister contract

contract.selective_unregister: Unregister removes only the specified callback owned by the plugin
contract.same_owner_isolation: Removing one callback does not remove other callbacks owned by the same plugin
contract.removed_callback_absence: The removed callback is absent from the listener registry
contract.remaining_callback_preservation: Other callbacks owned by the same plugin remain registered
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful after selective callback unregister
contract.registry_stability: Selective callback removal does not corrupt the listener registry
contract.permission_enforcement: Register, unregister, and emit operations require the events permission
